name: SO-101-force-kit.zip
text:
SO-101 force kit (TAL221 500 g + HX711 + Arduino Nano)

so101_force/so101_force.ino  Arduino Nano firmware. Library: "HX711 Arduino Library" by Bogdan Necula 0.7.5. Serial 115200.
force_probe.py               PC script: monitor / tare / cal / raw / push. Needs: pip install pyserial (push also needs LeRobot).
stl/probe_block.stl          Clamp block (gripped by the SO-101 jaws). PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 40% infill or more.
stl/probe_tip.stl            Probe tip, screwed to the free end (no wires) of the TAL221.
cad/probe_tool.scad          Same jig in OpenSCAD. Measure your load cell and edit hole_pitch, hole_from_end, cell_head_len, clamp_w.
cad/gen_probe_tool.py        Python generator for the same jig (manifold3d + trimesh).
first_move.py                First LeRobot test for the SO-101 follower.

Screws: 2 x M3x10 (fixed end), 2 x M3x12 + 2 x M3 nuts (probe tip). One small zip tie for the jaws, one for the wires.
These files were written for the SO-101 SOP. Firmware compiled for arduino:avr:nano; scripts tested offline only, not on real hardware.
